text:
nina: Quick flag - APAC POC blocked. Customer pinned `redwood-v2-13b` in ap-northeast-1 and requests are failing with a deprecation/availability error. Kicked off tomorrow's demo. Need options now.

 omar: Can you paste exact SDK call + error? also are they on Hosted/Dedicated/Private?

 nina: They're on Dedicated trial scoped to their org (acct-11077). JS SDK call looks like: `client.generate({model: 'redwood-v2-13b', input: '...'})`. Error shown in their console:
 ```json
{"error":"model_deprecated_or_unavailable","message":"Model redwood-v2-13b not available for dedicated pools in ap-northeast-1 (org=acct-11077)."}
```

 lila: Hmm — we rolled a regional deprecation for larger 13b variants in ap-northeast-1 in Feb due to capacity + licensing sync. For dedicated trials the artifact isn't replicated by default. Two quick moves: (A) allow fallback to `redwood-v2-13b-compat` (we maintain a compatible variant) or (B) re-pin to `redwood-v2-7b-quant` if the customer can tolerate model size drop.

 nina: Customer insists on using 13b family for parity with prod. They also raised a security questionnaire question: "Does artifact replication to another region traverse public internet?" They want assurance about in-transit controls.

 sre-bot: Security note: artifact replication uses our internal transfer fabric over peered cloud networks, encrypted in transit. If customer needs air-gapped transfer, ops requires a signed waiver and dedicated transfer window.

 omar: For the demo timeline: fastest path is enabling fallback to `redwood-v2-13b-compat` (operator config change on their Dedicated pool). That takes ~15min if they approve. Full replication of the 13b artifact to ap-northeast-1 requires infra ticket and depends on quota, ~48-72h.

 lila: Also saw intermittent 429s in their retries — likely client-side aggressive backoff. Recommend they implement exponential backoff + jitter. If they flood retries, the pool will surface 429s and block the demo.

 nina: They asked about cost/perf tradeoffs: 13b-fp16 vs 13b-quant vs 7b-quant. Any quick figs I can share?

 omar: Rough numbers (ballpark for POC): 13b-fp16 ~ $0.22 / 1k tokens, 13b-quant ~ $0.14 / 1k tokens, 7b-quant ~ $0.045 / 1k tokens. Latency: 13b-fp16 p50 ~ 95ms/token, 13b-quant p50 ~ 110ms/token (quant overhead), 7b-quant p50 ~ 70ms/token. For interactive short-turn demos, 13b-fp16 often feels snappier despite higher cost.

 salesops: I'll draft a short options email to the customer: 1) enable fallback to compat variant now (fast), 2) request artifact replication (48-72h), 3) demo on hosted with private tenancy (requires quick billing change). Which option does Eng recommend?

 lila: Recommend option 1 for demo + open replication ticket in parallel. We'll also provide the security note for the questionnaire.

 sre-bot: Ticket created: INC-99222 - Request replication of `redwood-v2-13b` artifacts to ap-northeast-1 for acct-11077. Estimated ETA 72h pending quota.

 nina: Customer accepted enabling fallback for the demo. They want the security blurb and perf/cost bullets in writing. I'll send today. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

 omar: If they later require strict pinning, we'll need signed approval for cross-region artifact push and a capacity commit. Keep me posted.

 nina: Will do. Closing for now but will re-open if replication ticket stalls.
